title: Splitting a Boolean Word
statement: If a Boolean word $w$ has length $m+1+r$ for natural numbers $m$ and $r$, then there are a Boolean word $u$, a Boolean $b$, and a Boolean word $v$ such that $w=u \, ++ \, [b] \, ++ \, v$, with $|u|=m$ and $|v|=r$.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean word w with length m+1+r
